_files_live_in: mpsc-question-bank repo - a DIFFERENT repo, hence this transcription
_paper_extraction: pdftotext -layout; the paper has a 24,404-char text layer so questions were parsed, not read by eye. Parser requires SEQUENTIAL question numbers and SEQUENTIAL option letters: an earlier version shredded Q62 because its option (d) is 'Both (b) and (c)' and the embedded markers were treated as new options, leaving option (c) EMPTY. Verified after fixing: 100 questions, every one with exactly options A-D, none empty.
_key_extraction: The key is a SCAN. Transcribed twice independently and required to agree: (1) tesseract --psm 4, taking the letters but deriving each question number from its row/column position rather than from OCR, because OCR misread the numbers (7 as 'z', 12 as 'i2', 72 as 'i'); (2) read off the rendered page by eye. Both reads agree on 100/100 entries.
_supersedes: The 7 October 2025 PROVISIONAL key differs from this final one at Q35 (B->C) and Q65 (C->D). The final governs.
